acceptanceMeaning.cost: Every actual potential attempt within each physical trial, including domain rejects, known/initial stage and fresh stage/endpoint samples, shares the 300-call cap. acceptanceMeaning.failure: A fully executed study may contain failed coarse-grid trials. Those rows cannot pass full-duration goals. Nonlinear convergence is not inferred from a small update or endpoint energy.
acceptanceMeaning.force: The 1e-35 N transformed stage residual is a diagnostic criterion; no equivalence to native stationarity or certified force enclosure is claimed.
acceptanceMeaning.motion: Check every accepted grid endpoint against the independent exact solution; retain any incomplete prefix/failing trial without time advancement. Positivity is inverse-model only.
acceptanceMeaning.persistence: After the primary run finishes, write an exclusive <=64MiB primary checkpoint before the second precision. The final exclusive result is separately <=64MiB. This diagnostic reserves both files prospectively (<=128MiB combined); no native/protected snapshot cap changes. Disagreement produces a saved result and nonzero exit; the checkpoint alone is neither a verified result nor a resume guarantee.
acceptanceMeaning.precision: 80/120-digit histories must share completion prefixes/decisions/reasons and differ at most1e-28 in each stored numeric field in its own units. Counters may differ and remain reported. No certified interval bound.
acceptanceMeaning.selection: Compare both state/work refinement and bounded solve behavior. No preselected winner; oscillator equality alone cannot choose a nonlinear method.
acceptanceMeaning.work: Actual stages supply power quadrature. Compare polynomial work with an independent exact continuous integral; inverse work is zero and energy is checked separately from state.
